     1→import pptxgen from 'pptxgenjs';
     2→import { saveAs } from 'file-saver';
     3→import type { InspectionData, PhotoData, AdditionalPart, PhotoCategory } from '@/types/report';
     4→import { t, type Language } from './translations';

     6→// Sanitize text for use in filenames
     7→function sanitizeForFilename(text: string): string {
     8→  return text
     9→    .trim()
    10→    .substring(0, 60)
    11→    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]/g, '')
    12→    .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    13→    .replace(/_+/g, '_')
    14→    .replace(/^_|_$/g, '')
    15→    || 'Inspecao';
    16→}
    17→
    18→// Helper function to generate a black image with white text
    19→function generateSerialNumberImage(serialNumber: string): string {
    20→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    21→  const width = 400;
    22→  const height = 400;
    23→  canvas.width = width;
    24→  canvas.height = height;
    25→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    26→  
    27→  if (ctx) {
    28→    // Black background
    29→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    30→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    31→    
    32→    // White text
    33→    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    34→    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    35→    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    36→    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    37→    
    38→    // Draw serial number
    39→    const displayText = serialNumber || 'N/A';
    40→    ctx.fillText(displayText, width / 2, height / 2);
    41→  }
    42→  
    43→  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    44→}

    53→  additionalParts: AdditionalPart[];

    76→
    77→export async function generatePowerPoint(options: PowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
    78→  const { inspection, photos, additionalParts, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
    79→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
    80→  
    81→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
    82→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
    83→  const finalPhotos = translatedData?.photos || photos;
    84→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
    85→  
    86→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
    87→  
    88→  // Set presentation properties
    89→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
    90→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
    91→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
    92→  
    93→  // Generate slides
    94→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
    95→  
    96→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
    97→  generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
    98→  
    99→  generatePhotoSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, language);
   100→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, additionalParts, language);
   101→  
   102→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   103→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   104→  }
   105→  
   106→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   107→  
   108→  // Save the file
   109→  const fileName = `Relatorio_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   110→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   111→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   112→}

   114→// ============================================
   115→// HOME POWERPOINT - Com Categorias
   116→// ============================================
   117→export async function generateHomePowerPoint(options: HomePowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
   118→  const { inspection, categories, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
   119→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   120→  
   121→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
   122→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
   123→  const finalCategories = translatedData?.categories || categories;
   124→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
   125→  
   126→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
   127→  
   128→  // Set presentation properties
   129→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   130→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   131→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   132→  
   133→  // Generate slides
   134→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   135→  
   136→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   137→  generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   138→  
   139→  // Generate category slides
   140→  finalCategories.forEach((category, index) => {
   141→    const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   142→    if (photosWithImages.length > 0) {
   143→      generateCategorySlides(pptx, category, index + 1, language);
   144→    }
   145→  });
   146→  
   147→  // Collect all parts from all categories for the parts table
   148→  const allPhotos: PhotoData[] = [];
   149→  const allAdditionalParts: AdditionalPart[] = [];
   150→  finalCategories.forEach(category => {
   151→    allPhotos.push(...category.photos);
   152→    allAdditionalParts.push(...category.additionalParts);
   153→  });
   154→  
   155→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, allPhotos, allAdditionalParts, language);
   156→  
   157→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   158→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   159→  }
   160→  
   161→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   162→  
   163→  // Save the file
   164→  const fileName = `Relatorio_Home_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   165→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   166→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   167→}
   168→
   169→// Helper function to get translated category title and description
   170→function getCategoryTranslation(categoryId: string, language: Language): { title: string; description: string } {
   171→  const titleKey = `category.${categoryId}`;
   172→  const descKey = `category.${categoryId}Desc`;
   173→  
   174→  return {
   175→    title: t(titleKey, language, { defaultValue: categoryId }),
   176→    description: t(descKey, language, { defaultValue: '' }),
   177→  };
   178→}
   179→
   180→function generateCategorySlides(
   181→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   182→  category: PhotoCategory, 
   183→  categoryNumber: number,
   184→  language: Language
   185→) {
   186→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   187→  const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   188→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   189→  
   190→  // Get translated title
   191→  const { title: translatedTitle } = getCategoryTranslation(category.id, language);
   192→  
   193→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   194→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   195→    
   196→    // Header with category number (use translated title, no line break)
   197→    addCategoryHeader(slide, `${categoryNumber}. ${translatedTitle.toUpperCase()}`);
   198→    
   199→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   200→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   201→    
   202→    // Photo 1
   203→    if (photo1?.imageData) {
   204→      addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, 0.3, 1.7, 4.4, 2.8, language);
   205→    }
   206→    
   207→    // Photo 2
   208→    if (photo2?.imageData) {
   209→      addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, 4.9, 1.7, 4.4, 2.8, language);
   210→    }
   211→    
   212→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   213→  }
   214→}

   391→function generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx: pptxgen, inspection: InspectionData, language: Language) {
   392→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   393→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   394→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'MACHINE IDENTIFICATION' : 'IDENTIFICAÇÃO DA MÁQUINA');
   395→  
   396→  // Title
   397→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Machine Identification' : 'Identificação da Máquina', {
   398→    x: 0.3,
   399→    y: 1.1,
   400→    w: 9.4,
   401→    h: 0.4,
   402→    fontSize: 16,
   403→    bold: true,
   404→    color: '000000',
   405→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   406→    align: 'center',
   407→  });
   408→  
   409→  // Photo positions (4 columns) - centered on slide
   410→  const photoWidth = 2.1;
   411→  const photoHeight = 2.1;
   412→  const gap = 0.3;
   413→  const totalWidth = (photoWidth * 4) + (gap * 3);
   414→  const startX = (10 - totalWidth) / 2; // Center the photo group
   415→  const photoY = 1.7;
   416→  
   417→  // Photo 1: Equipamento
   418→  const photo1X = startX;
   419→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   420→    x: photo1X,
   421→    y: photoY,
   422→    w: photoWidth,
   423→    h: photoHeight,
   424→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   425→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },
   426→  });
   427→  
   428→  if (inspection.machinePhoto) {
   429→    slide.addImage({
   430→      data: inspection.machinePhoto,
   431→      x: photo1X,

   433→      w: photoWidth,
   434→      h: photoHeight,
   435→      sizing: { type: 'cover' },

   437→  } else {
   438→    // Placeholder with camera icon

   442→      w: photoWidth,
   443→      h: 0.5,
   444→      fontSize: 24,
   445→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   446→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   447→      align: 'center',
   448→    });
   449→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Equipment Photo' : 'Foto do Equipamento', {
   450→      x: photo1X,
   451→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   452→      w: photoWidth,
   453→      h: 0.35,
   454→      fontSize: 8,
   455→      color: '999999',
   456→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   457→      align: 'center',
   458→      italic: true,
   459→    });
   460→  }
   461→  
   462→  // Label 1: TAG
   463→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   464→    x: photo1X,
   465→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   466→    w: photoWidth,
   467→    h: 0.4,
   468→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   469→  });
   470→  slide.addText(inspection.tag || (isTranslated ? 'Equipment TAG' : 'TAG do Equipamento'), {

   472→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,

   481→

   597→    bold: true,
   598→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   599→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   600→    align: 'center',
   601→  });
   602→  
   603→  // Photo 4: Local
   604→  const photo4X = startX + (photoWidth + gap) * 3;
   605→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   606→    x: photo4X,
   607→    y: photoY,
   608→    w: photoWidth,

   670→
   671→function generatePhotoSlides(pptx: pptxgen, photos: PhotoData[], language: Language) {
   672→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   673→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   674→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   675→  
   676→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   677→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   678→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PHOTOS' : 'FOTOS');
   679→    
   680→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   681→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   682→    
   683→    // Photo 1
   684→    if (photo1?.imageData) {
   685→      addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, 0.3, 1.6, 4.4, 2.8, language);
   686→    }
   687→    
   688→    // Photo 2
   689→    if (photo2?.imageData) {
   690→      addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, 4.9, 1.6, 4.4, 2.8, language);
   691→    }
   692→    
   693→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   694→  }
   695→}
   696→
   697→function addPhotoToSlide(
   698→  slide: pptxgen.Slide, 
   699→  photo: PhotoData, 
   700→  x: number, 
   701→  y: number, 
   702→  w: number, 
   703→  h: number,
   704→  language: Language
   705→) {
   706→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   707→  
   708→  // Check if we have a secondary photo (two photos side by side)
   709→  const hasSecondaryPhoto = photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData;
   710→  
   711→  // Calculate photo widths
   712→  const photoWidth = hasSecondaryPhoto ? (w - 0.1) / 2 : w;
   713→  
   714→  // Photo info overlay (if PN exists)
   715→  if (photo.pn) {
   716→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   717→      x: x,
   718→      y: y - 0.4,
   719→      w: w,
   720→      h: 0.35,
   721→      fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 70 },
   722→    });
   723→    
   724→    let infoText = `${isTranslated ? 'Part Number:' : 'Numero da Peça:'} ${photo.pn}`;
   725→    if (photo.partName) infoText += ` ${photo.partName}`;
   726→    if (photo.quantity) infoText += ` ${isTranslated ? 'Qty:' : 'Qtd:'} ${photo.quantity}`;
   727→    
   728→    slide.addText(infoText, {
   729→      x: x + 0.1,
   730→      y: y - 0.35,
   731→      w: w - 0.2,
   732→      h: 0.25,
   733→      fontSize: 9,
   734→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   735→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   736→    });
   737→  }
   738→  
   739→  // Primary Photo
   740→  if (photo.imageData) {
   741→    slide.addImage({
   742→      data: photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData || '',
   743→      x: x,
   744→      y: y,
   745→      w: photoWidth,
   746→      h: h,
   747→      sizing: { type: 'cover' },
   748→    });
   749→  }
   750→  
   751→  // Secondary Photo (lado a lado)
   752→  if (photo.secondaryImageData) {
   753→    const secondX = hasSecondaryPhoto ? x + photoWidth + 0.1 : x;
   754→    const secondW = hasSecondaryPhoto ? photoWidth : w;
   755→    
   756→    slide.addImage({
   757→      data: photo.secondaryImageData,
   758→      x: secondX,
   759→      y: y,
   760→      w: secondW,
   761→      h: h,
   762→      sizing: { type: 'cover' },
   763→    });
   764→  }
   765→  
   766→  // Description
   767→  if (photo.description) {
   768→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   769→      x: x,
   770→      y: y + h,
   771→      w: w,
   772→      h: 0.6,
   773→      fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   774→    });
   775→    
   776→    slide.addText(photo.description.substring(0, 150), {
   777→      x: x + 0.1,
   778→      y: y + h + 0.05,
   779→      w: w - 0.2,
   780→      h: 0.5,
   781→      fontSize: 8,
   782→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   783→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   784→    });
   785→  }
   786→}
   787→
   788→// Interface for hierarchical parts structure
   789→interface PartRow {
   790→  pn: string;
   791→  serialNumber: string;
   792→  partName: string;
   793→  quantity: string;
   794→  isSubPart: boolean;
   795→  parentPn?: string;
   796→  indent: number;
   797→}
   798→
   799→function generatePartsTableSlides(
   800→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   801→  photos: PhotoData[], 
   802→  additionalParts: AdditionalPart[],
   803→  language: Language
   804→) {
   805→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   806→  // Build hierarchical parts structure
   807→  const partRows: PartRow[] = [];
   808→  
   809→  // Process each main part and its sub-parts
   810→  photos
   811→    .filter(p => p.pn)
   812→    .forEach(photo => {
   813→      // Add main part
   814→      partRows.push({
   815→        pn: photo.pn,
   816→        serialNumber: photo.serialNumber || '',
   817→        partName: photo.partName || '-',
   818→        quantity: photo.quantity || '-',
   819→        isSubPart: false,
   820→        indent: 0,
   821→      });
   822→      
   823→      // Find and add all sub-parts for this main part
   824→      const subParts = additionalParts.filter(ap => ap.parentPn === photo.pn);
   825→      subParts.forEach(subPart => {
   826→        partRows.push({
   827→          pn: subPart.pn,
   828→          serialNumber: subPart.serialNumber || '',
   829→          partName: subPart.partName,
   830→          quantity: subPart.quantity,
   831→          isSubPart: true,
   832→          parentPn: photo.pn,
   833→          indent: 1,
   834→        });
   835→      });
   836→    });
   837→  
   838→  // Add any orphan additional parts (without a parent in the current photos)
   839→  const parentPns = new Set(photos.filter(p => p.pn).map(p => p.pn));
   840→  additionalParts
   841→    .filter(ap => !parentPns.has(ap.parentPn))
   842→    .forEach(orphanPart => {
   843→      partRows.push({
   844→        pn: orphanPart.pn,
   845→        serialNumber: orphanPart.serialNumber || '',
   846→        partName: orphanPart.partName,
   847→        quantity: orphanPart.quantity,
   848→        isSubPart: false,
   849→        parentPn: orphanPart.parentPn,
   850→        indent: 0,
   851→      });
   852→    });
   853→  
   854→  if (partRows.length === 0) return;
   855→  
   856→  // Calculate slides needed (8 rows per slide - peças principais + sub-peças)
   857→  const rowsPerSlide = 8;
   858→  const slidesNeeded = Math.ceil(partRows.length / rowsPerSlide);
   859→  
   860→  for (let slideIndex = 0; slideIndex < slidesNeeded; slideIndex++) {
   861→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   862→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PARTS TABLE' : 'TABELA DE PEÇAS');
   863→    
   864→    // Table title with page indicator if multiple slides
   865→    const titleText = slidesNeeded > 1 
   866→      ? `${isTranslated ? 'Parts Table' : 'Tabela de Peças'} (${slideIndex + 1}/${slidesNeeded})`
   867→      : (isTranslated ? 'Parts Table (Part Number)' : 'Tabela de Peças (Numero da Peça)');
   868→    
   869→    slide.addText(titleText, {
   870→      x: 0.5,
   871→      y: 1.2,
   872→      w: 8,
   873→      h: 0.4,
   874→      fontSize: 14,
   875→      bold: true,
   876→      color: '000000',
   877→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   878→    });
   879→    
   880→    // Table header
   881→    const headerY = 1.7;
   882→    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   883→      x: 0.5,
   884→      y: headerY,
   885→      w: 9,
   886→      h: 0.4,
   887→      fill: { color: '000000' },
   888→    });
   889→    
   890→    const headers = [
   891→      { text: isTranslated ? 'PN (Serial)' : 'PN (Serial)', x: 0.5, w: 2.5 },
   892→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Part Name' : 'Nome da Peça', x: 3, w: 3 },
   893→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Qty' : 'Qtd', x: 6, w: 1 },
   894→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Type' : 'Tipo', x: 7, w: 2.5 },
   895→    ];
   896→    
   897→    headers.forEach(header => {
   898→      slide.addText(header.text, {
   899→        x: header.x,
   900→        y: headerY + 0.05,
   901→        w: header.w,
   902→        h: 0.3,
   903→        fontSize: 10,
   904→        bold: true,
   905→        color: 'FFFFFF',
   906→        fontFace: 'Arial',
   907→        align: 'center',
   908→      });
   909→    });
   910→    
   911→    // Table rows
   912→    const startIdx = slideIndex * rowsPerSlide;
   913→    const endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + rowsPerSlide, partRows.length);
   914→    const slideParts = partRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
   915→    
   916→    let rowY = headerY + 0.4;
   917→    const rowHeight = 0.35;
   918→    
   919→    slideParts.forEach((part, idx) => {
   920→      // Row background - different colors for main and sub-parts
   921→      const bgColor = part.isSubPart ? 'FFF5E6' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'F8F9FA' : 'FFFFFF');
   922→      slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   923→        x: 0.5,
   924→        y: rowY,
   925→        w: 9,
   926→        h: rowHeight,
   927→        fill: { color: bgColor },
   928→        line: part.isSubPart ? { color: 'FFE0B2', width: 0.5 } : undefined,
   929→      });
   930→      
   931→      // Sub-part indicator (arrow or dash)
   932→      if (part.isSubPart) {
   933→        slide.addText('└─', {
   934→          x: 0.5,
   935→          y: rowY + 0.05,
   936→          w: 0.3,
   937→          h: rowHeight - 0.1,
   938→          fontSize: 9,
   939→          color: 'FF6600',
   940→          fontFace: 'Arial',
   941→          align: 'center',
   942→          valign: 'middle',
   943→        });
   944→      }
   945→      
   946→      // Part Number with Serial (with indent for sub-parts)
   947→      const pnX = part.isSubPart ? 0.75 : 0.5;
   948→      const pnText = part.serialNumber 
   949→        ? `${part.pn} (${part.serialNumber})`
   950→        : part.pn;
   951→      slide.addText(pnText, {
   952→        x: pnX,
   953→        y: rowY + 0.05,
   954→        w: part.isSubPart ? 2.25 : 2.5,
   955→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
   956→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
   957→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'CC5200' : '000000',
   958→        fontFace: 'Arial',
   959→        align: 'center',
   960→        valign: 'middle',
   961→        italic: part.isSubPart,
   962→      });
   963→      
   964→      // Part Name
   965→      slide.addText(part.partName, {
   966→        x: 3,
   967→        y: rowY + 0.05,
   968→        w: 3,
   969→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
   970→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
   971→        color: part.isSubPart ? '666666' : '000000',
   972→        fontFace: 'Arial',
   973→        align: 'center',
   974→        valign: 'middle',
   975→        italic: part.isSubPart,
   976→      });
   977→      
   978→      // Quantity
   979→      slide.addText(part.quantity, {
   980→        x: 6,
   981→        y: rowY + 0.05,
   982→        w: 1,
   983→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
   984→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
   985→        color: '000000',
   986→        fontFace: 'Arial',
   987→        align: 'center',
   988→        valign: 'middle',
   989→      });
   990→      
   991→      // Type column
   992→      const typeText = part.isSubPart 
   993→        ? (isTranslated ? '↳ Sub-part' : '↳ Sub-peça')
   994→        : (isTranslated ? 'Main' : 'Principal');
   995→      
   996→      slide.addText(typeText, {
   997→        x: 7,
   998→        y: rowY + 0.05,
   999→        w: 2.5,
  1000→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1001→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1002→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'FF6600' : '000000',
  1003→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1004→        align: 'center',
  1005→        valign: 'middle',
  1006→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1007→      });
  1008→      
  1009→      rowY += rowHeight;
  1010→    });
  1011→    
  1012→    addStandardFooter(slide);
  1013→  }
  1014→}

  1215→function addStandardFooter(slide: pptxgen.Slide) {
  1216→  slide.addText('© 2024 - Departamento de Manutenção Industrial | Todos os direitos reservados', {
  1217→    x: 0.3,
  1218→    y: 7,
  1219→    w: 9.4,
  1220→    h: 0.3,

  1228→function formatDateForFileName(dateString: string): string {
  1229→  if (!dateString) return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  1230→  
  1231→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues
  1232→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1233→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1234→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1235→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1236→    const year = parts[0];
  1237→    return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1238→  }
  1239→  
  1240→  // Fallback: use current date
  1241→  const today = new Date();
  1242→  const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  1243→  const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  1244→  const year = today.getFullYear();
  1245→  return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1246→}
  1247→
  1248→function formatDateForDisplay(dateString: string): string {
  1249→  if (!dateString) return '';
  1250→  
  1251→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues (YYYY-MM-DD format)
  1252→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1253→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1254→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1255→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1256→    const year = parts[0];
  1257→    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  1258→  }
  1259→  
  1260→  return dateString;
  1261→}
